title: BOX OF VINTAGE BOOKS
reason: Three Georgette Heyer volumes in period bindings (edition unconfirmed; a first printing of The Conqueror or Devil's Cub would be worth real money) plus an Enid Blyton Noddy and Victorian and Edwardian children's books.
findings: Box of mostly children's and Victorian books, with three Georgette Heyer volumes visible on the spines in photo 2: 'Venetia' (white grey dust jacket with a framed spine panel and a red edge), 'Devil's Cub' (buff linen cloth with blue title, a blue decorative band and Heyer's facsimile signature in blue script) and 'The Conqueror' (cream ribbed spine with red title and an ornament between title and author). No publisher, date or printing is legible on any spine, so first edition status is unconfirmed; the spine styles look period (1930s to 1950s) but the printing cannot be told from the photos. Other books seen: 'The Wonderful Animal Book' (horse and foal picture cover), 'Noddy Meets Father Christmas' by Enid Blyton (picture boards, Sampson Low style), 'The Dog Crusoe and His Master' by R.M. Ballantyne (Martyn Library, ed. Howard Marshall, orange and blue swallow jacket), 'The Precious Gift: Bible Stories for Children', a 'BIRTHDAY S...' annual with a girl's portrait, 'Robinson Crusoe', a picture book spine reading '...PAMINONDAS', a black cloth Victorian gilt blocked book with an illegible title lozenge, a green cloth book and 'Kettle on the Hob'.
condition: Heavily worn overall. 'Devil's Cub' has flaking and loss at the spine foot and fraying at the head; the 'Venetia' jacket spine is dusty and faded with a red edge; 'The Conqueror' spine looks clean apart from small specks at the head; several annuals have chipped or split spines, rubbed boards and foxed edges; 'The Precious Gift' and the Noddy book have rubbed, soiled covers.
rescore_note: Worn box of vintage children's and Victorian books; the three Heyer volumes show no publisher or printing, so a first is unproven and unlikely given the wear (spine loss, foxing); better extras are a Noddy and a jacketed Martyn Library Ballantyne; $30-80 band. No comp seen.
